title: Ordered ledger digest
description: Consume every event in order, call audit exactly once per event, and return the final rolling digest. Pilot annotation material; not validated benchmark ground truth.
source: Original synthetic program authored with Codex assistance for the requested Phase-1 pilot on 2026-09-18. No independent researcher authorship or review is claimed; not copied from an external repository.

computational_intent.description: Consume every event in order, call audit exactly once per event, and return the final rolling digest.

semantic_oracle.description: Consume every event in order, call audit exactly once per event, and return the final rolling digest. Check the declared input domain, edge cases and effects using the classical tests; this draft is not a registered quantum semantic oracle.

config.input_domain: events is a finite list of bytes; audit is a callback with externally visible effects and may raise.

assumptions: The audit callback must run on the classical host, exactly in input order.
Every event affects the digest; each intermediate audit digest is observable.
The one-pass full ledger is the required output contract; there is no hidden existential query.
